When two imports define a keyword with the same name, a bare call is
**ambiguous** — Robot Framework refuses to guess and fails the test. You resolve
it by **qualifying** the call: prefix the keyword with its source and a dot.

This chapter's workspace imports two resources, `common.resource` and
`backup.resource`, that both define `Greet`. The suite `checks/imports.robot`
calls `Greet` unqualified, so it fails. Download this lesson's lab, then qualify it.

> **Warning:** Import order does not silently pick a winner. An ambiguous
> keyword is an error you must resolve, not a coin flip.

```diagram
stack "Resolving a keyword name conflict"
Greet :dashed :muted -- unqualified call
arrow two imports define it
Ambiguous — RF refuses to guess :outline -- the test fails
arrow qualify with Source.Keyword
common.Greet -- names the resource explicitly
arrow resolves to
common.resource's Greet :pass -- the test passes
```

## Task 1 — Qualify the ambiguous keyword with its resource name

**Goal:** in `checks/imports.robot`, change the ambiguous `Greet` call so it
names the resource it should come from, and the test passes.

Here is the qualification syntax on a keyword you already know — `Log` from the
built-in library. `Source.Keyword` picks the definition explicitly.

<!-- example -->
```robotframework
*** Test Cases ***
Qualified Call Is Unambiguous
    BuiltIn.Log    named its library explicitly
```
<!-- /example -->

**Check:** `checks/imports.robot` qualifies the call as `common.Greet`, and the
test passes.

<!-- hint -->
Both resources define `Greet`. Prefix the call with the resource that owns the
one you want — the file name without its `.resource` extension.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- hint -->
Change `Greet    world` to `common.Greet    world` to select the definition from
`common.resource`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- solution -->
```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Resource    ../resources/common.resource
Resource    ../resources/backup.resource

*** Test Cases ***
Greeting Works
    common.Greet    world
```
<!-- /solution -->

## Task 2 — Run the suite green

Run it:

```bash
uv run robot checks
```

**Check:** the test `Greeting Works` passes.
